name: Curse of Conformity — scoped to the enchanted player, not the caster
notes: Memory: project_enchant_player_2026-04-26. 'Creatures enchanted player controls' is rewritten to 'you control' at parse time; without the _enchantedPlayerScoped override it would hit the caster's creatures instead. Curse enchants the opponent: their Runeclaw Bear becomes a 3/3 with no subtypes, while the caster's own Grizzly Bears keeps Bear and stays 2/2.
